A L’Oréal está presente em 150 mercados nos cinco continentes. Por mais de um século, a L’Oréal se dedicou exclusivamente a "Criar a beleza que move o mundo"; agora é a líder mundial do setor, com €42 bilhões em vendas consolidadas. Juntos, resolvemos desafios complexos em escala, garantindo nosso compromisso em tornar o mundo um lugar mais inclusivo e melhor para todos e para o nosso planeta.

Missão

Como Gerente de E-commerce na Divisão de Produtos de Grande Público, você será responsável por liderar a estratégia comercial e a execução do negócio nos canais de e-commerce, impulsionando crescimento sustentável, excelência na operação e forte parceria com clientes e stakeholders internos. Esta posição terá gestão direta de 2 executivos de contas e papel-chave na construção dos planos de crescimento, na condução das negociações comerciais e na aceleração da agenda digital da divisão. Buscamos um perfil com forte orientação para resultados, alta capacidade de execução, senso de dono(a), proatividade e elevada accountability sobre o negócio. Uma pessoa com energia, agilidade e mentalidade de “fazer acontecer”, capaz de transformar estratégia em entregas concretas e gerar impacto real nos resultados.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Liderar a estratégia de e-commerce nos clientes/canais sob sua responsabilidade.
  • Gerenciar, desenvolver e acompanhar a performance de 2 executivos de contas, garantindo clareza de prioridades e alto nível de execução.
  • Construir e desdobrar planos de crescimento por cliente, categoria e canal, em linha com as ambições da divisão e das marcas.
  • Liderar o relacionamento comercial com clientes estratégicos do ambiente digital, conduzindo negociações e fortalecendo parcerias de longo prazo.
  • Garantir excelência na execução do calendário promocional, lançamentos, ativações e planos comerciais.
  • Monitorar e gerir os principais KPIs do negócio, como sell-in, sell-out, GMV, market share, rentabilidade e performance promocional.
  • Identificar riscos e oportunidades a partir de análises de performance, tendências de mercado e dinâmica competitiva.
  • Atuar de forma transversal com áreas como Marketing, Trade Marketing, Supply, Finanças e demais stakeholders para destravar temas e acelerar resultados.
  • Liderar revisões de negócio e planos de ação com foco em performance, disciplina de execução e melhoria contínua.
  • Assegurar alto nível de accountability do time e forte foco em entrega.

Conhecimentos Necessários

  • Experiência sólida em e-commerce, comercial digital, key account ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência em gestão de clientes e negociação comercial.
  • Vivência com construção de planos comerciais, calendário promocional e gestão de indicadores de performance.
  • Experiência prévia com liderança de pessoas ou forte potencial de gestão.
  • Forte capacidade analítica e orientação para tomada de decisão baseada em dados.
  • Habilidade para atuar em ambiente dinâmico, com priorização, agilidade e senso de urgência.
  • Excelente relacionamento interpessoal e capacidade de influência.
  • Perfil proativo, executor e com alta accountability.
  • Inglês desejável, conforme escopo da função.

O que você vai encontrar

  • Possibilidade de crescimento, incluindo carreira internacional;
  • Ambiente inclusivo e diverso;
  • Cultura voltada para pessoas, pessoas e pessoas!

Estamos empenhados em garantir processos de recrutamento inclusivos e em defender a contratação e promoção de cada candidato de forma ética e equitativa.

O Grupo proíbe estritamente a discriminação contra qualquer candidato a emprego devido à identidade ou expressão de gênero do indivíduo, orientação sexual, deficiência visível e/ou invisível, origem socioeconômica e/ou multicultural, condições de saúde, idade, religião ou quaisquer outras características protegidas por lei.

Temos orgulho de ser um empregador que oferece oportunidades iguais.

Our Vision

Our goal is to create the largest and most influential DeFi ecosystem the world has ever seen, starting with becoming the gold standard in DeFi education. This vision is ambitious, transformative, and poised to change the landscape of digital finance.

Are You Ready?

This is more than just a job; it’s an opportunity to shape the future of Web3 technology and education. Are you ready to be part of our vision to redefine what’s possible in DeFi and beyond? Apply below, and let’s explore this journey together.

Check us out here: Decentralized Masters

What will you be doing?

The Sales Operations Specialist is responsible for ensuring the sales organization operates with speed, accuracy, visibility, and accountability. This role owns the day‑to‑day execution and optimization of the sales tech stack—primarily HubSpot—so that Membership Directors (MDs), Setters, and Sales Leadership can focus on selling, not admin.

This is a hands‑on, systems‑focused role, not a people manager. You will work closely with Sales Leadership, Marketing, Fulfillment, and Data to maintain clean pipelines, automate workflows, enforce process discipline, and deliver reliable reporting.

At Decentralized Masters, Sales Ops is mission‑critical. This role directly impacts close rates, cash collection, forecasting accuracy, and the overall scalability of the revenue engine.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own accuracy of HubSpot CRM configuration: pipelines, deal stages, properties, workflows, and permissions.
  • Ensure every lead, deal, and contact has correct lead status, lifecycle stages, ownership, and next steps.
  • Maintain strict data hygiene standards (identifying/merging duplicates, no stale deals, missing properties, or broken workflows).
  • Enforce CRM usage standards across Setters and MDs.

Sales Automation & Workflow Management

  • Build and maintain automation for:
  • Lead routing and assignment
  • Task creation and follow‑ups
  • Deal stage progression
  • Call outcomes and disposition tracking
  • Reduce manual admin work for sales reps wherever possible.
  • QA all automations to ensure reliability and compliance.
  • Maintain accurate, real‑time visibility into:
  • Pipeline value and velocity
  • Close rates and conversion metrics
  • DPL (Deals Per Lead), APS, and other core KPIs
  • Build and maintain sales dashboards for leadership.
  • Support forecasting and revenue reporting in collaboration with Finance and Data teams.
  • Manage and support integrations between HubSpot and:
  • Calendars and scheduling tools
  • Payment platforms (e.g., Whop)
  • Analytics and BI tools
  • Troubleshoot system issues and coordinate fixes with internal tech or third‑party vendors.

Process Enforcement & Enablement

  • Translate sales process changes into CRM logic and automation.
  • Partner with Sales Leadership to ensure systems reinforce desired behaviors.
  • Create and maintain SOPs for sales roles, systems and workflows.
  • Act as the point person for Sales Ops requests, improvements, and bug fixes.
  • Support and respond to Sales Ops requests submitted via Slack channels.

Compliance & Data Integrity

  • Ensure CRM processes align with internal compliance standards (FTC/SEC‑aware language, DISCLAIMERS, documentation).
  • Maintain audit‑ready records for sales activity and deal history.
  • Partner with Security/IT on access control and data governance.

Requirements

What do you bring?

Required Experience

  • 2–5+ years in Sales Operations, RevOps, or CRM Administration
  • Hands‑on experience with HubSpot (required)
  • Strong background in sales automation and workflow design
  • Experience supporting high‑ticket or complex sales cycles preferred.

Skills & Attributes

  • Highly systems‑oriented and detail‑driven
  • Strong understanding of sales metrics and funnels
  • Comfortable working cross‑functionally with Sales, Marketing, Fulfillment, and Data
  • Proactive problem‑solver who spots issues before they become revenue problems
  • Clear communicator who can translate business needs into system logic

Bonus (Nice to Have)

  • Experience in high‑growth, remote‑first environments
  • Familiarity with Whop, aloware, or BI tools
  • Exposure to compliance‑heavy industries (finance, education, crypto, etc.)

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation
  • Remote‑first culture with a globally distributed team.
  • Opportunity to own the organic growth engine of a fast‑scaling DeFi brand.
  • Access to cutting‑edge tools, data, and creative freedom to innovate.
  • A values‑driven company culture that rewards results, autonomy, and excellence.

If you are ready to take on a challenge that will shape the future of crypto finance and grow with a team of innovators, we want to hear from you!

title: Transportation Specialist, ROC
description:
ROC (Relay Operations Center) is the centralized command and control center for ‘Transportation Execution’ across the Amazon Supply Chain network supporting multiple geographies like NA, EU, India, Mexico, Brazil etc. It ensures hassle free, timely pick‑up and delivery of freight from vendors to Amazon fulfillment centers (FC) and from Amazon FCs to carrier hubs. In case of any exceptions, ROC steps in to resolve the issues by keeping the stakeholders informed on the proceedings. Along with tactical problem solving ROC is also charged with understanding trends in network exceptions and then automating processes or proposing process changes to streamline operations. This second aspect involves network monitoring and significant analysis of network data. Overall, ROC plays a critical role in ensuring the smooth functioning of Amazon transportation and thereby has a direct impact on Amazon’s ability to serve its customers on time.

Overview of a Transportation Specialist

A Transportation Specialist at ROC facilitates the flow of information between different stakeholders (Trans Carriers/Hubs/Warehouses) and resolves any potential issues that impact customer experience and business continuity. The role works across two verticals – Inbound and Outbound operations. Inbound Operations deals with Vendor/Carrier/FC relationships, ensuring that freight is picked‑up on time and delivered to FC as per the given appointment. Outbound Operations deals with FC/Carrier/Carrier Hub relationships, ensuring that the truck leaves the FC to deliver customer orders as per promise. A Transportation Specialist provides timely resolution by researching and querying internal tools, taking real‑time decisions, analyzing data, noticing trends, and driving customer experience without compromising on time. The ideal candidate should understand basic logistics, communicate clearly in written and oral form, ideate process improvements, and drive them to completion.

Responsibilities

  • Communicate with external customers (Carriers, Vendors/Suppliers) and internal customers (Retail, Finance, Software Support, Fulfillment Centers)
  • Provide real‑time customer experience in a 24/7 operating environment
  • Systematically escalate problems or variances in information and data to relevant owners and teams, and follow through on resolutions
  • Develop and/or understand performance metrics to assist with driving business results
  • Communicate effectively, both verbally and in writing, to create narratives outlining weekly findings, variances to goals, and present these findings in a review forum
  • Work within various time constraints to meet critical business needs, measuring and identifying activities performed
  • Quickly understand the business impact of trends and make decisions that make sense based on available data

title: Research Assistant
description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Basic Function

Howard University is currently seeking a highly motivated and organized Research Assistant to work on a federally funded research study related to COVID-19. The Research Assistants will be primarily responsible for recruiting potential adult participants at Howard University Hospital in Washington DC and the neighboring communities. Participants to be enrolled for the study are past COVID-19 patients. The study seeks to assess Long COVID prevalence and associated risk factors.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Screen electronic medical records to identify eligible study participants, contact potential participants in a timely manner.
  • Obtain informed consent in accordance with research protocols, procedures, and good clinical practice guidelines.
  • Administer survey assessments and enter data in REDCap.
  • Perform and document risk assessments.
  • Attend mandatory study specific trainings and team meetings.
  • Complete and file daily paperwork accurately and in a timely manner.
  • Organize and maintain study participants’ data and extract medical data as needed.
  • Document accurate encounters and shift events, adhere to all study procedures, and communicate daily/weekly updates to study coordinator and recruitment lead.
  • Assist the follow-up team in preparing participants’ scheduling and completing follow-up visits virtually and in person.
  • Other duties deemed necessary to maintain smooth operations of the research program such as biospecimen preparation, packaging and mailing to the biorepository core.

Core Competencies

As a critical component to the success of the study, the primary responsibility of the Research Assistants will be patients’ engagement, community outreach, and participants’ enrollment in the study. Personable, detail-oriented, flexible with scheduling, able to work independently and as part of a team.

Minimum Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Sciences, Public Health or health-related fields.

Previous research experience, clinic/hospital work or volunteer experience, and knowledge of the research process is preferred. This position requires flexibility and availability to adapt to patients’ schedules. Reliable transportation is necessary to complete participants’ interviews at various community locations. Spanish language is a plus.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

$40,000-$50,000

title: Quais Empresas De Ônibus No RJ Estão Contratando Motorista
description:
✅ Empresas de ônibus como Viação Redentor, Real Auto Ônibus e Transportes Flores estão contratando motoristas no RJ.

Atualmente, várias empresas de ônibus no Rio de Janeiro estão com processos seletivos abertos para a contratação de motoristas. Essas oportunidades são frequentes devido à alta demanda por profissionais capacitados para atuar no transporte público, sobretudo em grandes centros urbanos como o RJ. Entre as empresas que estão contratando, destacam-se companhias que operam linhas municipais, intermunicipais e interestaduais, oferecendo vagas que normalmente exigem CNH categoria D ou E, além de experiência comprovada.

Este artigo detalha quais são as principais empresas de ônibus no Rio de Janeiro que estão contratando motoristas atualmente, explicando os requisitos básicos para se candidatar, as formas de inscrição e os benefícios que essas empresas costumam oferecer. Além disso, abordamos dicas importantes para quem deseja ingressar nessa área, incluindo informações sobre o mercado de trabalho, a demanda por motoristas e os cuidados para escolher a vaga ideal.

Empresas de ônibus no RJ com vagas abertas para motoristas

  • Viação 1001 – Atua nas linhas interestaduais e intermunicipais, frequentemente buscando motoristas com experiência e CNH categoria D ou E.
  • Viação São Silvestre – Opera linhas municipais em vários bairros do RJ e costuma abrir vagas para motoristas, principalmente em períodos de alta demanda.
  • Auto Viação Jabour – Empresa tradicional no transporte público urbano do RJ, que em algumas épocas contrata profissionais para reforço em suas operações.
  • Viação Novo Rio – Especializada em linhas urbanas e rodoviárias, frequentemente disponibiliza vagas para motoristas qualificados.
  • Viação Redentor – Conhecida pelo transporte intermunicipal, mantém processos seletivos regulares para motoristas profissionais.

Requisitos legais e habilitação

Antes de mais nada, o candidato precisa possuir Carteira Nacional de Habilitação (CNH) na categoria D ou E , que permite a condução de veículos com mais de 8 passageiros . Além disso, a Certificação de Curso MOPP (Movimentação Operacional de Produtos Perigosos) pode ser exigida por algumas empresas, especialmente para linhas que eventualmente transportem cargas específicas.

  • CNH categoria D ou E válida e regularizada;
  • Comprovante de residência atualizado;
  • Certificado do curso MOPP (quando aplicável);
  • Atestado de saúde ocupacional para garantir aptidão física e mental;
  • Currículo atualizado com experiência comprovada na função.

Requisitos comuns para motoristas de ônibus no RJ

  • CNH categoria D ou E: obrigatória para condução de veículos de transporte coletivo.
  • Experiência comprovada: muitas empresas exigem no mínimo 1 a 2 anos de experiência como motorista de ônibus.
  • Curso de Transporte Coletivo: certificado pelo DETRAN, necessário para alguns processos seletivos.
  • Exame médico e psicológico: para garantir a aptidão física e mental do candidato.
  • Disponibilidade de horário: Muitas vagas exigem trabalho em turnos, finais de semana e feriados.

Competências Comportamentais e Técnicas

  • Responsabilidade e atenção redobrada ao trafegar em vias urbanas e rodoviárias sob condições variadas;
  • Boa comunicação para lidar com passageiros e equipe;
  • Conhecimento das rotas e pontos turísticos do RJ;
  • Capacidade de resolução rápida de problemas e situações de emergência;
  • Resistência física para longas jornadas de trabalho.

Benefícios comuns oferecidos para motoristas de ônibus no RJ

  • Vale-transporte, vale-refeição, assistência médica e planos de carreira são comuns nas empresas do setor.

Média salarial para motoristas de ônibus no Rio de Janeiro

A média varia entre R$ 1.800 a R$ 3.000, dependendo da empresa, turno e benefícios oferecidos.

Pontos-chave sobre Contratação de Motoristas de Ônibus no RJ

  • Empresas principais: Viação 1001, Viação Penha, Auto Viação Redentor, Viação Sul Fluminense.
  • Requisitos: CNH D, experiência anterior, curso especializado em transporte coletivo.
  • Salário médio: R$ 1.800 a R$ 3.000 mensais, com benefícios inclusos.
  • Onde buscar vagas: Sites oficiais, plataformas de emprego (InfoJobs, Indeed, LinkedIn).
  • Processo seletivo: Pode incluir testes práticos, entrevistas e análise de documentação.
  • Benefícios comuns: Vale-transporte, vale-refeição, assistência médica, seguro de vida.
  • Mercado: Alta demanda por motoristas qualificados devido ao transporte coletivo urbano no RJ.

  • If applicable, the duties and responsibilities in the safety case for this position must be observed.
  • Full participation in emergency drills and respond to emergency situations as per assigned duties on the station bill.

Operational Discipline Requirements

  • Disciplined application and participation in the Task Planning & Risk Assessment Process.
  • Understanding and perform the roles and responsibilities as assigned at the pre‑job meeting.
  • Understanding the hazards associated with the task.
  • Understanding and effectively implementing the control measures required to mitigate identified hazards.
  • Execute all tasks and task steps in a disciplined manner, following the sequence detailed in the relevant procedures.
  • Recognize at‑risk behavior or conditions during tasks and call ‘Time out for Safety’ when unsure, or when the job does not go as planned.
  • Participate in After Action Reviews to feedback lessons learned from performing the task.

HSE Requirements

  • Report all incidents, potential hazards or abnormal situations to supervisors.
  • Actively execute work in accordance with Company Safety Processes, e.g. START, Task Planning Risk Assessment and use of the Prompt Card, Safe Manual Handling, Working at Heights, etc.
  • Call a Time Out for Safety (TOFS) when you do not understand the plan, when an unsafe condition is observed, or perceived, anytime personal impairment is recognized, when it’s not clear what will happen next, or the hazards and associated risks for the task changes.
  • Participate in the execution of the rigs ‘Hold the Zero’ plan.
  • Comply with the company requirements to safeguard ‘lone workers.’
  • Maintain a safe and organized work area throughout all tasks and on completion of tasks.
  • Incorporate the Task Planning and Risk Assessment process into all tasks, whether working alone or as part of a team.
  • Apply the START process during the execution of planned tasks and daily operations.
  • Ensure subordinate personnel are properly trained in the START process.
  • Ensure subordinates are trained prior to using the permit to work (PTW) process.
  • Approve all PTW as designated by the Master/OIM through the Control of Work Process; ensure all task steps and controls are understood and any other activities that may be affected are identified before approving the PTW.
  • Call a Time Out for Safety (TOFS) whenever an unplanned hazard or a change in the expected results is observed.
  • Ensure that the Company QHSE policies and other programs are communicated to and understood by all personnel.
  • Play an active part in the weekly meetings, FOCUS Improvement Program, and all other Company safety management systems.
  • Ensure that a high standard of hygiene and housekeeping is maintained within the Areas of Responsibility.
  • Ensure that subordinates understand their roles as related to the Emergency Response Plan and are capable of responding to emergency situations as designated on the station bill.
  • Ensure all required well control drills are performed and evaluate all personnel’s responses; Conduct After Action Reviews and ensure that findings are communicated to the crew and lessons learned captured.
  • Ensure that DROPS inspections are conducted as per the rig’s DROPS inspection program.

Duties

  • The underlying expectation is that all duties are carried out in compliance with the Company Operational Discipline expectations and HSE requirements.

Operations/Maintenance – General Duties

  • Perform maintenance and repair of all MPD equipment inclusive of surface manifolds, RCD and MPD IRJ components and associated surface equipment such as the HPU, HCS, reels and accessories.
  • Lead the onsite operation of the MPD IRJ and associated components ensuring compliance with the relevant policies and procedures.
  • Train and mentor subsea department on all MPD IRJ related tasks.
  • A good understanding of all regulatory documentation such as API 16RCD, API 92S etc.
  • Supervise all MPD equipment inspection requirements and advise relevant members of any deficiencies.
  • Identify any potential equipment or operational issues and report using the correct processes.
  • Complete sealing element evaluation reports and any other required field documentation and upload to AIM. Ensure MPD manager is copied in distribution.
  • Lead all IRJ rig up and operational procedures.
  • Complete AAR of every MPD IRJ deployment and retrieval. Submit to MPD manager.
  • Record all equipment associated downtime in AIM and ensure MPD manager is copied.
  • Advise on correct sealing element sizing and properties for each bearing assembly deployment.
  • Troubleshoot all MPD equipment and implement corrective action.
  • Ensure all equipment is current and complete to latest revision levels including operation manuals.
  • Competent in the use of the MPD control software.
  • Perform various other duties and activities as assigned by supervisor within the physical constraints of the job.
  • Liaise with equipment OEMs to ensure latest policies and procedures are adhered to.

description:
Um vendedor de loja desempenha um papel crucial em garantir que os clientes tenham uma experiência de compra satisfatória e eficiente.

As principais responsabilidades de um vendedor incluem:

  • Atendimento ao Cliente: Receber e saudar os clientes, oferecer assistência na escolha de produtos, responder a perguntas e fornecer informações detalhadas sobre itens e promoções.
  • Apresentação e Demonstração de Produtos: Mostrar produtos aos clientes, explicar suas características e benefícios, e fazer recomendações com base nas necessidades e preferências dos clientes.
  • Processamento de Vendas: Ajudar no processo de checkout, que pode incluir operar a caixa registradora ou sistema de ponto de venda (PDV), embalar produtos e realizar transações de pagamento.
  • Gestão de Estoque: Monitorar níveis de estoque, reabastecer prateleiras e expositores, e garantir que os produtos estejam sempre disponíveis e bem apresentados.
  • Organização da Loja: Manter a loja limpa e organizada, rearranjar produtos e garantir que a área de vendas esteja sempre atraente e acessível para os clientes.
  • Promoções e Ofertas: Informar os clientes sobre promoções e ofertas especiais, e incentivá-los a aproveitar essas oportunidades.
  • Resolução de Problemas: Lidar com reclamações e problemas dos clientes de maneira eficiente e profissional, buscando soluções que atendam às necessidades dos clientes e mantenham a boa reputação da loja.
  • Atingir Metas de Vendas: Trabalhar para atingir ou superar as metas de vendas estabelecidas pela loja, usando técnicas de vendas e estratégias para maximizar as oportunidades.
  • Atualização e Treinamento: Manter-se atualizado sobre os produtos, tendências de mercado e políticas da loja, participando de treinamentos e reuniões conforme necessário.
  • Feedback e Melhoria Contínua: Fornecer feedback à gerência sobre as necessidades dos clientes e quaisquer problemas que possam impactar a experiência de compra, contribuindo para melhorias contínuas na operação da loja.

Essas responsabilidades ajudam a criar uma experiência de compra positiva, aumentar as vendas e fortalecer o relacionamento com os clientes, o que é essencial para o sucesso de nossas lojas.

Descrição

Vita Check-up

Sobre a vaga: Buscamos uma Técnica de Patologia qualificada, dedicada e com boa comunicação para integrar nossa equipe multidisciplinar. Você será responsável por promover o encantamento do cliente por meio da condução segura, humanizada e eficiente dos processos de assistência, coleta de exames laboratoriais, preparo e envio de amostras, avaliações de bioimpedância e demais procedimentos de preparo para o check‑up. Atuar na prevenção e solução de intercorrências, assegurando excelência na experiência do cliente, mantendo a liderança informada e solicitando providências quando necessário. Prestar assistência às necessidades básicas dos clientes (higiene, conforto e apoio emocional), zelando continuamente por sua segurança e bem‑estício durante toda a jornada no serviço.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Realizar coleta de exames laboratoriais, incluindo punção venosa para coleta de sangue, seguindo protocolos técnicos e de biossegurança.
  • Executar avaliações de bioimpedância e outros procedimentos de preparo dos clientes para exames.
  • Preparar amostras biológicas para envio à análise técnica, incluindo identificação, centrifugação, acondicionamento, armazenamento e rastreabilidade.
  • Cadastrar informações de exames nos sistemas laboratoriais, de imagem e demais avaliações, garantindo fluxo ágil e seguro de atendimento.
  • Acompanhar e prestar apoio aos clientes durante a realização do check‑up, oferecendo orientações e suporte sempre que necessário.
  • Organizar salas de atendimento, conferindo formulários, equipamentos e materiais, inclusive controle de validade.
  • Avaliar necessidade de materiais permanentes (ex.: braçadeira de PNI, cabos, sensores) e descartáveis, solicitando reposição e preenchendo check‑lists.
  • Executar limpeza, desinfecção e esterilização de equipamentos e superfícies, conforme protocolos institucionais.
  • Zelar pelo uso adequado e conservação dos equipamentos, comunicando anormalidades à liderança imediata.
  • Cumprir estratégias e diretrizes da Diretoria, participando de reuniões e rituais de gestão quando solicitado.

Competências funcionais e técnicas

  • Conhecimento e experiência em coleta de sangue e demais exames laboratoriais.
  • Domínio dos processos de preparo de amostras biológicas (centrifugação, identificação, acondicionamento e envio).
  • Conhecimento de biossegurança e uso adequado de EPIs conforme NR‑32.
  • Noções de atendimento humanizado ao cliente em ambiente de saúde.
  • Capacidade de registro correto de informações em sistemas.

Executive Administrative Assistant (Remote)

This opportunity is designed for experienced administrative professionals who are comfortable supporting leadership teams, coordinating business priorities, and ensuring operations run smoothly in fast-paced remote environments.

Required:

The Technical Implementation Specialist is responsible for bridging the gap between our core LPPA extraction tool engine and our clients’ downstream internal systems. The team's core mission is to solve the “Last Mile” problem in data delivery and utilization, specifically focusing on custom integration. Our platform excels at transforming unstructured investment documents into structured data. However, this data only achieves its full value when it seamlessly integrates with a client's existing downstream systems (such as eFront, Investran, or internal ERPs). The Custom Integration Lead acts as the crucial bridge between our core data extraction engine and these client‑specific systems. This role is responsible for ensuring the extracted data is immediately actionable within the client’s unique technical environment.

Department: Ticketing, Hospitality & Stadium Revenue

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

Reporting organisationally to the Senior Ticketing Operations Manager the Ticketing Stadium Configuration Manager will help building and maintaining stadium seating maps for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. Working in close collaboration with the Configuration and Inventory team in Zurich and other key individuals responsible for the management of ticketing inventory, seating plans and its maintenance in the Ticketing System, ensuring data accuracy throughout the planning phase and during the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Serve as the central liaison to FIFA Zurich, facilitating alignment on strategic priorities, reporting, and operational updates
  • Provide hands‑on support and guidance to the local team, ensuring they have the resources, information, and leadership needed to deliver high‑quality operational outcomes
  • Support and build accurate seating plans in the ticketing system for FIFA tournament venues of the host country
  • Manage and oversee the implementation of all necessary seating information and configuration of spectator flows, price categories, seat allocations and carry out required updates
  • Maintain on day‑to‑day basis seating maps and configurations within the ticketing system throughout all stages of FIFA tournaments and apply changes as required
  • Ensure data integrity and accuracy of all seating information and configuration
  • Evaluate outcomes of quality inspections and propose corrective measures
  • Carry out the seat allocation and seat assignment process in the ticketing system
  • Assess and analyse maps and plans of FIFA tournament venues to identify gaps and changes to be applied in the seating plans and configurations
  • Plan, prepare and carry out on‑site seat inspection visits to fully validate seating plans as built in the ticketing system with the actual venue seating
  • Support the overall management of ticketing inventory by conducting quality assurance measures for both ticket quotas and seat allocations
  • Administer allocations and additional ticket requests during the tournaments
  • Support general ticketing operations for FIFA events

YOUR PROFILE

Education / Experience

  • Bachelor degree or similar level of education
  • Experience working with ticketing systems (preferably Secutix)
  • 5 years of professional experience
  • 1–3 years of experience in ticketing or similar functional area (first experiences in creating seating maps or floor plans in a software application of advantage)
  • Experience in data analytics and/ or management
  • Onsite ticketing operations experience
  • Experience in working with CAD technical drawings
  • Native‑level fluency in Brazilian Portuguese and English; proficiency in additional languages is valued.

Skills & Competencies

  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, SharePoint, Teams, Visio & Project) and planning software and online collaboration tools
  • Ability to work independently, managing multiple priorities
  • Ability to coordinate across functional areas such as security, broadcasting, hospitality
  • Strong analytical skills, detail‑oriented, technology‑minded, efficient and accountable team player
  • Ability to adapt to working with different environment and time zones

Certifications & Requirements

  • Willingness to travel to host cities.
  • Availability to work extended hours during test events and tournament time.
  • Experience working in international, multicultural environments preferred.
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English
  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Ability to relocate to Rio de Janeiro.

  • Gerenciar a rotina de operação dos Prédios Industriais (Centrais e Datacenters) com ênfase na manutenção preventiva, preditiva e corretiva de equipamentos de infraestrutura, definindo procedimentos de atuação, padrões de qualidade e confiabilidade da planta;

title: Software Maintenance Engineer
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world’s leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office‑based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder‑led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring a Software Maintenance Engineer to work in a dynamic and exciting engineering role in Linux‑based infrastructure and applications. You will cover all layers of the stack, including bare metal, virtualization (KVM), containerization (Docker/LXC/LXD), storage (Ceph and Linux file systems), networking (OVS, OVN and Core networking), OpenStack, Kubernetes and the open source applications running on top of them. It will challenge you to show the breadth of your engineering skills, which will be needed to work on almost any aspect of Ubuntu and the open source applications large enterprise customers run.

This role deals with critical issues in the open source stack that require upstream bug fixes. Our engineers are able to work productively at any level of the stack including the kernel and in a wide range of languages, to understand and address the software issues at hand. Our group is critical to the success of our customers, partners and Ubuntu itself. You will help with troubleshooting and driving issues to resolution with workarounds, guidance, and bug fixes to be released upstream and in Ubuntu.

Location: This is a remote role, we have teams in all time zones.

The role entails

  • Resolve complex customer problems related to Ubuntu, Kernel, Ceph, OpenStack, or Kubernetes and other open source software
  • Maintain a close working relationship with Canonical’s Field, Support and product engineering teams
  • Participate in upstream communities
  • Develop bug fixes, backport patches, and work with upstream for inclusion
  • Review code produced by other engineers
  • Demonstrate good judgment in technical methods and techniques
  • Prioritize work and manage your time effectively against those priorities
  • Participate in team discussions to improve processes, tools, and documentation
  • Maintain clear, technical and concise communications
  • Work from home and travel internationally up to 10% of work time for team meetings, events and conferences

What we are looking for in you

  • An exceptional academic track record
  • Background in Computer Science, STEM or similar
  • Experience with Linux and open source software
  • Experience with at least one of Python, Go, C or C++ on Linux
  • A drive to learn unfamiliar technology and deep‑dive difficult issues
  • Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events

Nice‑to‑have skills

  • You love technology and working with brilliant people
  • You are curious, flexible, articulate, and accountable
  • You value soft skills and are passionate, enterprising, thoughtful, and self‑motivated
  • You have interest in, or willingness to learn about, any of the following: Ubuntu Linux – kernel or userspace, Kubernetes, OpenStack, Ceph, QEMU/KVM, LXC/LXD, PostgreSQL, Mongo, Debian packaging, distributed systems

What we offer colleagues

  • Distributed work environment with twice‑yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long‑haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open‑source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer. We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Job Description

The position The Corporate Communications Senior Manager will lead strategic planning and delivery of communications and public relations strategies and activities for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, ensuring the tournament is powerfully positioned in line with FIFA’s overall strategic objectives and the FIFA Women’s Football Strategy.

This role is responsible to support the Head of Communications & Media Relations in the rollout and implementation of the Communications components of the tournament’s Marketing & Communications Strategy, with a strong focus on Brazil and South America. The position plays a central role in leading the development and implementation of proactive corporate communications that enhance FIFA’s reputation, raise awareness on the tournament, influence public perception, engage with internal and external stakeholders for higher impact and ensures consistency across proactive and reactive messaging at a global level.

Reporting jointly to the Head of Communications & Media Relations based in Brazil and to the Team Lead Corporate Communications in Switzerland, the Corporate Communications Senior Manager collaborates with senior stakeholders, decision-makers, and leadership teams to translate corporate priorities and tournament objectives into engaging, credible narratives.

Key responsibilities

  • Lead and implement a corporate communications-first approach, delivering proactive, strategic messaging and storytelling across Brazil and South America in line with the Marketing & Communications Strategy.
  • Develop messaging for tournament milestones, events, initiatives, campaigns, announcements and key FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ functional areas.
  • Act as the central integrator for communications-related matters, coordinating internal and external stakeholders including FIFA27 functional teams, Host City communications teams, federal, state and municipal authorities, the CBF, and other key partners.
  • Develop and implement pre-emptive communications plans to manage risk, address sensitive topics and engage targeted audiences.
  • Develop issues and crisis communications planning and execution within FIFA27 in close alignment with the FIFA Communications Division, supporting all relevant partners and activities in the lead-up to and during the tournament.
  • Build close working relationships with other Marketing and Communications teams to ensure narrative unity and operational efficiency.
  • Partner with the Media Relations department to identify and amplify proactive stories that shape public understanding of FIFA’s initiatives.
  • Partner with digital, editorial, and campaign teams to deliver integrated storytelling across FIFA’s ecosystem.
  • Perform other duties directly related to the role, as required by FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ leadership or the FIFA Communications Division.

Your profile

  • Minimum 7 years experience in communications, media and public relations, with experience in similar leadership positions
  • Familiarity with the world of football. Passion for women’s football is a plus
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written) and Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Spanish language skills are an asset
  • Able and willing to travel up to 50% of the year
  • Able and willing to work non-traditional hours including evenings and weekends as needed
  • Ability to relocate to Rio de Janeiro.

About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup™ is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

title: Sales Analyst
description:
Overview


FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.


Department and Location


Department: Partnerships & Media


Location: Brazil


The Position


The Sales Analyst will support the sponsorship sales team with research, analysis and data on potential sponsors. She/He will be responsible for generating research reports, data sets, market/category/brand specific insights and sales materials as well as the management of the Business Development Directory.


She/He will also be responsible for supporting the sales team in building compelling sales presentations utilising a range of internal and external data and partner case-studies. A key role in supporting sponsorship sales and strategic partnerships for the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™, with a strong focus on the Brazilian and LATAM markets.


The role requires deep market knowledge, a robust network in the region, and the ability to communicate fluently in English and Portuguese. Spanish is considered a plus.


Key Responsibilities



  • Work closely with the Head of Partnership Sales, FIFA Women’s World Cup Sales Lead and the broader commercial team to deliver on sponsorship sales objectives for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, with a strong emphasis on the Brazilian and LATAM markets.

  • Work closely with the Partnership Sales team to deliver sponsorship and sales objectives, identifying and pursuing high-value sponsorship leads aligned with the commercial strategy of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.

  • Support the sales team research function, building compelling sales presentations utiliseing a range of internal and external data and partner case-studies.

  • Conduct in-depth desk and internet research.

  • Produce a range of materials (in collaboration with creative team) to support the sales managers throughout commercial discussions.

  • Become primary liaison with external suppliers and various internal research departments.

  • Support the sales team in sourcing, qualifying, and engaging potential sponsors, supporting generating tailored partnership proposals for major regional and international brands.

  • Ensure timely and accurate update and management of the CRM system for the FWWC27 Commercial team

  • Collaborate with the Strategy and Planning team to identify market opportunities and build compelling sales arguments.

  • Stay informed on emerging sponsorship categories, regional industry trends, and relevant market research, including pricing and inventory benchmarks.

  • Support the organisation of commercial events, conferences, hosting programmes, dedicated to cultivating business relationships and building into the sales pipeline.


Your Profile



  • Highly professional, articulate and results-driven.

  • Proven experience in similar roles within sponsorship sales, business development, or commercial partnerships, preferably in sports or entertainment.

  • Experience using consumer insights platforms (ex. GlobalWebIndex)

  • Exposure to media value reports and how they’re used in sponsorship

  • Familiarity with market research platforms and broader sponsorship market

  • Strong understanding of the Brazilian and LATAM commercial landscape.

  • Ability to work independently in a multi-task position within a dynamic, team-based environment.

  • Solutions orientated.

  • Solid time management and organizational skills.

  • Internal client oriented, efficient and effective.

  • Adept at handling and protecting confidential information.

  • Excellent team player and relationship builder.

  • Attention to detail, reliable and responsible.

  • An appreciation of the international sports federation environment, passion for women’s sports and global events.

  • University degree in business, sports marketing or related area

  • Excellent in Word / PowerPoint / Excel / PDF / MS Teams / Salesforce and other CRM tools

  • Fluent in English and Portuguese, any other FIFA language (Spanish especially) is an advantage

  • Ability to travel often and when required.

  • Right to work in Brazil.

  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

title: Integrity Engineer
description:
Job Function:

Employment Type: Permanent

Yinson is a dynamic, equal opportunity employer with great organisational culture where people are valued and empowered to deliverpowerful solutions.

Sumary:

Yinson Brasil Serviços Ltda is seeking a dedicated Integrity Engineer. This important role supports the onshore operations with a key focus on maintaining and assuring the integrity and safe operation of FPSOunits and associated equipment.

As an Integrity Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in safeguarding the company’s interests by ensuring all inspection, testing, and maintenance activities on critical equipment are carried out with high standards of safety, compliance, and efficiency. You will be integral to a team committed to operational excellence and proactive risk management within the offshore oil and gas sector.

Key Responsibilities

  • Organise and oversee the activities related to NR 13 / SPIE compliance in collaboration with equipment inspectors from FPSO units, including maintaining comprehensive and up-to-date documentation such as official books, calibration certificates, inspection reports, and audit records.
  • Manage internal and external inspection schedules, ensuring adherence to regulatory and company standards, while maintaining close coordination with operation managers to integrate inspection activities within shutdown plans effectively.
  • Lead the evaluation and implementation of training programs for Equipment Inspectors, Operators, and Technicians to uphold competency and safety standards across all levels of operations.
  • Maintain and regularly update the equipment master list to reflect current status and compliance details.
  • Define testing, measurement, replacements, repairs, and modification schedules based on written procedures, ensuring the physical condition of critical equipment meets operational safety requirements.
  • Ensure rigorous verification and performance testing of safety valves and other safety-critical equipment, either by performing, witnessing, or overseeing such tests to guarantee reliable operation.
  • Conduct audits of equipment manufacturers as required, supporting thorough supplier qualification and quality assurance.
  • Collaborate effectively with internal stakeholders (Yinson teams) and external parties (clients, contractors) to foster transparent communication and alignment on objectives and compliance requirements.
  • Perform additional duties as assigned by management in support of the company’s goals and regulatory compliance.
  • Commercial Awareness: Understand the wider business context and how operational integrity relates to company performance and risk management.
  • Safeguarding Company Interest: Demonstrate commitment to protecting company assets, reputation, and operational continuity.
  • Cost Control Experience: Apply cost control principles within offshore oil and gas projects to optimise expenditure without compromising safety or quality.
  • Teamwork: Work collaboratively across multi-disciplinary teams and with external partners, fostering a positive and productive working environment.
  • Communication Skills: Communicate effectively at all organisational levels, both verbally and in writing, ensuring clarity and professionalism in all interactions.
  • Analytical and Problem-Solving Abilities: Use strong analytical skills to assess equipment conditions, interpret inspection data, and develop practical solutions.
  • Attention to Detail: Maintain accuracy in documentation, procedures, and reporting to support compliance and operational excellence.
  • Responsibility and Proactivity: Take ownership of tasks, demonstrate initiative, and work in a hands‑on manner to achieve targets and resolve issues promptly.

Qualifications and Experience

  • Engineering degree is mandatory.
  • CREA‑RJ accreditation is required.
  • Post‑Graduation degree in a relevant field will be considered a strong advantage.
  • Experience as an Operations Engineer within the Brazilian oil and gas sector, with experience specifically in integrity engineering preferred.
  • Proven experience working with FPSO projects and offshore operations is highly desirable.
  • Fluent English and Portuguese verbal and written communication skills to effectively liaise with diverse teams and stakeholders.

Why Join Us?

At Yinson Brasil Serviços Ltda, you will become part of a forward‑thinking and inclusive team dedicated to safe and sustainable offshore operations. We value initiative and provide opportunities for professional growth within a dynamic sector. Our collaborative culture encourages knowledge sharing and continuous improvement, enabling you to make a tangible impact in a challenging and rewarding environment.

If you are a focused, detail‑oriented professional with a strong commitment to equipment integrity and operational safety, and you thrive in a team‑oriented setting, this role offers an excellent platform to advance your career in offshore production.

title: Senior Manager Human Resources Latam
description:
Location: Rio de Janeiro, RJ, BR

Work Arrangement: Hybrid

At Dover Fueling Solutions (DFS), we are taking fueling and convenience retail to the next level. We are passionate about cultivating excellence in everything we do, but what really fuels us is our people. They’re the heart of our company. As an employee, our promise to you is that you’ll work on new and innovative products and solutions, be mentored by managers and teammates who are collaborative, caring, and act with integrity, and have the opportunity to grow in ways that are meaningful to you. Unique and interesting projects – both locally and globally – will challenge you and allow you to pursue different and rewarding career paths.

Position Summary

The Senior Manager, Human Resources LATAM serves as a strategic and tactical business partner to the LATAM team, driving the execution of HR strategies for the region. Reporting to the Director, Human Resources EMEA & SAL and based out of our factory in Rio de Janeiro, this role oversees all aspects of HR—including talent acquisition, compensation and benefits, learning and development, talent management, employee relations, policy design, and HR operations.

Operating as a primary business partner for the Rio manufacturing site and the wider regional business, the Senior Manager fosters a high-performance, employee-centric culture. This role emphasizes quality, productivity, and empowerment while ensuring all HR initiatives are aligned with global, regional, and local strategies to drive business success.

Key Responsibilities

Specific responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Strategic HR Leadership & Business Partnership
    • Provide HR leadership and functional support across multiple departments, including Operations, Sourcing, Sales, Customer Service, and Legal.
    • Ensure HR strategies are effectively aligned with business priorities, fostering an adaptable and high-performing workforce.
    • Provide expert consultation to managers and senior leaders on HR-related matters.
    • Collaborate across departments to ensure a seamless employee experience and a strong people strategy.
  • Partner with leadership and regional Talent Development to counsel on employee impact decisions, supporting workforce planning, succession, and development initiatives.
  • Lead efforts to enhance talent mobility and strengthen leadership capabilities within the organization.
  • Manage talent engagement processes, including recruitment, compensation, promotions, training, and performance management, in partnership with the local HR team.
  • Support global mobility for key employees, collaborating with global mobility teams and HR peers.
  • Employee Engagement and culture
    • Cultivate a high-performance, inclusive work environment that aligns with Dover values and DFS’ company culture.
    • Support initiatives that enhance employee engagement, workplace satisfaction, and long-term retention.
  • Consult with business leaders to drive organizational design, change management, and leadership development strategies.
  • Diagnose workforce gaps and design solutions for regional and local implementation.
  • Oversee succession planning processes, fostering leadership development and career progression for key talent.
  • HR Operations, compliance & leadership
    • Manage, guide, and mentor HR team members based in Rio de Janeiro.
    • Ensure compliance with local labor laws and global HR requirements.
    • Develop and implement HR policies and procedures, ensuring alignment with corporate guidelines.
    • Monitor and manage key HR metrics, providing data-driven insights for business decisions.

Candidate Experience and Qualifications

The ideal candidate will bring strategic HR leadership at both local and regional levels, with experience in fast-paced, evolving business environment.

  • Bachelor’s degree in human resources management or business administration.
  • Experience in partnering with senior leadership teams.
  • Experience in multiple locations.
  • Fluent Portuguese and English language skills, both verbal and written, Spanish is a preference.
  • Exceptional critical thinking skills: ability to decompose complex problems, prioritize issues, and implement sensible solutions.
  • Track record of creating strong partnerships and influencing at all levels of the organization.
  • Superior interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to increase productivity and continuously improve methods, approaches.
  • Experience in organizational development and change management.
  • Proven ability to work in a fluid, fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to maintain a high level of confidentiality.

Dover Fueling Solutions is an equal opportunity employer and affords equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants regardless of race, color, religion, creed, age, gender, sexual orientation, genetic information, marital status, national origin, disability, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, provincial or local law. Dover Fueling Solutions conforms to the spirit as well as to the letter of all applicable laws and regulations.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without discrimination on the basis of race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, age, genetic information, or any other factors prohibited by law.

description:

A Leve Saúde é uma operadora de saúde carioca que nasceu com opropósito de transformar a forma como o cuidado em saúde é oferecido no Brasil . Acreditamos que cuidar vai muito além de oferecer planos — é construir relações, escutar de verdade e estar presente na jornada de cada pessoa.

Desde o início, apostamos em um modelo mais próximo, acolhedor e resolutivo. Com equipes próprias e rede integrada, promovemos uma experiência de saúde mais leve, eficiente e centrada no paciente.

  • Tornar o cuidado em saúde mais humano e acessível.
  • Reduzir burocracias e facilitar o acesso a serviços de qualidade.
  • Usar a tecnologia como aliada para melhorar a experiência e os resultados em saúde.
  • Com clínicas próprias, prontas para atender com acolhimento e eficiência.
  • Com uma equipe multidisciplinar que acompanha de perto a jornada dos beneficiários.
  • Com um time interno comprometido com inovação, qualidade e propósito.

Somos uma empresa em constante crescimento, e cada colaborador é parte essencial dessa construção. Aqui dentro, acreditamos em colaboração, em diálogo e no poder de fazer diferente.

  • Receber os pacientes com empatia, cordialidade e atenção desde a chegada à clínica;
  • Realizar o acolhimento inicial, identificando necessidades e oferecendo suporte personalizado;
  • Orientar sobre procedimentos, horários, documentos e fluxo da clínica;
  • Esclarecer dúvidas sobre consultas, exames, encaminhamentos e demais serviços;
  • Realizar autorização de guias junto a operadoras de saúde (via sistemas como TISS ou plataformas específicas);
  • Efetuar o recebimento de atendimentos particulares, incluindo emissão de recibos e controle de pagamentos;
  • Acompanhar o paciente durante sua jornada, garantindo conforto e tranquilidade;
  • Após a consulta, verificar como foi a experiência e oferecer suporte adicional, se necessário;
  • Atuar como ponte entre paciente e equipe médica/administrativa, promovendo comunicação clara;
  • Receber e organizar documentos, correspondências e resultados de exames;
  • Auxiliar em tarefas administrativas como preenchimento de fichas, arquivamento e atualização de cadastros;
  • Manter a recepção limpa, organizada e funcional.

Requisitos:

  • Ensino médio completo;
  • Excelente comunicação verbal e escuta ativa;
  • Postura acolhedora, empática e proativa;
  • Experiência com atendimento ao público, preferencialmente em ambientes de saúde;
  • Capacidade de lidar com situações delicadas com sensibilidade e discrição.

Diferenciais:

  • Superior em áreas da saúde, humanas ou hospitalidade é um diferencial;
  • Experiência com atendimento humanizado;
  • Conhecimento do sistema Tasy;
  • Conhecimento básico em sistemas de gestão ambulatorial;
  • Participação em treinamentos de hospitalidade ou experiência do cliente.
  • Vale Refeição: R$42,00/dia (com desconto simbólico de R$1,00/mês);
  • Day Off no dia do aniversário;
  • Plano de Saúde (sem desconto em folha);
  • Plano Odontológico (sem desconto em folha);
  • Total Pass (bem-estar e atividade física);
  • Descontos com instituições de ensino;
  • Universidade Corporativa Leve.

Prazer, somos a Leve Saúde!

Somos um grupo que tem como missão democratizar o acesso à saúde privada e ser referência em solução de saúde ambulatorial no Rio de Janeiro.

Buscamos um profissional que possa garantir assistência médica segura e eficaz por meio da execução de procedimentos clínicos e cirúrgicos, contribuindo para a recuperação e bem-estar dos pacientes.

Atividades

SPA

  • Realizar medição de sinais vitais (pressão arterial, temperatura, frequência cardíaca, respiratória, saturação de oxigênio), conforme prescrição médica ou protocolo da instituição, para avaliar o estado de saúde do paciente e detectar alterações precoces.
  • Fazer e trocar curativos simples conforme a necessidade ou prescrição médica, para promover a cicatrização e prevenir infecções.

Centro Cirúrgico

  • Exercer funções de circulante auxiliando o cirugião e equipe cirúrgica na montagem de sala e administrando os materiais da cirurgia.
  • Dar suporte ao Enfermeiro na triagem, preparando e orientando os pacientes.

  • Controlar e solicitar rouparia, materiais e medicamentos utilizados na área.
  • Fazer a lavagem e preparação do material de cirgurgia.

Endoscopia

  • Auxiliar a equipe médica na realização dos exames.
  • Fazer a desinfecção e controle dos aparelhos utilizados nos exames.
  • Preparar o paciente e realizar montagem da sala para os exames.

Ambulatório

  • Organizar e dar suporte para os médicos de procedimentos em consultório.
  • Organizar e repor estoque de materiais, medicamentos e aparelhos necessários para os atendimentos.
  • Organizar agendas médicas, diariamente, para garantir a organização das consultas e procedimentos médicos.

title: Billing Analyst
description:
About the Role We are hiring a Billing Analyst (Contracts & Invoicing) to support a high-volume, enterprise B2B billing operation within the telecommunications industry. This role owns the contractual and invoicing control stages of the Order-to-Cash process, acting as a quality, compliance, and accuracy gate between approved Purchase Orders and customer invoices. The position requires strong ERP execution, billing governance, and cross-functional organization. Key Responsibilities Execute and control the Contracts & Invoicing stages of the Order-to-Cash process. Validate sales orders and invoices against Purchase Orders (POs), contracts, pricing references, and billing structures. Create, update, and validate Sales Orders in ERP systems. Prepare and review invoice drafts, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and audit readiness. Manage invoice issuance, correction, and cancellation workflows with full traceability. Register invoices and supporting documentation in official repositories. Submit or share invoices through customer portals and approved channels. Coordinate with Sales, Contracts, Projects, PMO, Warehouse, and Finance to obtain required billing inputs. Track invoice status, blockers, aging, and SLAs, ensuring disciplined follow-up. Required Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Law, or related fields. Experience in Billing, Invoicing, Contract Administration, or Revenue Operations. Strong knowledge of Order-to-Cash (O2C) processes. Hands-on experience with ERP systems (TOTVS Protheus highly desirable). Advanced Microsoft Excel skills (controls, reconciliations, reporting). Working knowledge of indirect taxation and invoice compliance. Professional proficiency in English. Preferred Qualifications Experience in telecommunications, infrastructure, or technology services. Exposure to enterprise or Tier-1 customers. Familiarity with invoice submission portals, acceptance workflows, and billing SLAs. Experience operating in high-volume, month-end driven environments. Facilitar a adoção de práticas ágeis entre as equipes, garantindo a compreensão e aplicação correta dos princípios e cerimônias. Monitorar riscos do projeto, sinalizando desvios de prazo, custo ou escopo para a gestão imediata e propor planos de ação corretivos. title: Analista De Trade Marketing Pleno - L'Oréal Produtos Profissionais
description: About Us Founded in 2019 by two best friends, Jon and Eli, XILO set out to revolutionize the insurance industry by solving its biggest challenges. Eli, a brokerage owner, brought invaluable industry expertise, while Jon, an experienced software engineer, saw an opportunity to innovate using technology. Initially launched as a vertical SaaS solution addressing core quoting challenges, XILO has since evolved into a trailblazing Vertical AI company leveraging the latest AI technology to transform the industry. By layering cutting-edge AI solutions onto its SaaS platform, XILO is driving innovation far beyond its original vision. Having recently closed our Series A funding round, XILO is growing rapidly and seeking talented individuals who want to do career-defining work in a mission-driven startup that's at the forefront of AI innovation. About The Role As a Senior Backend Engineer, you'll be designing and architecting scalable solutions, creating robust APIs, and building new microservices from the ground up—while also improving and optimizing our existing systems. This isn't just another engineering role. We're solving real, painful inefficiencies in the insurance space – problems so frustrating that prospects have nearly teared up during sales calls, realizing how much time and effort we could save them. What we're building isn't just an upgrade – it's a fundamental shift in how agencies operate. What You'll Do: Architect and develop scalable TypeScript microservices powering XILO's platform. You'll have the opportunity to work where your strengths shine and contribute to: AI Agents – Automating complex decision-making and workflows OCR & Document Processing – Extracting, structuring, and analyzing key insights from insurance documents Intelligent Data Mapping – Aggregating and linking all relevant data into a centralized, dynamic user profile Advanced Insurance Operations & CRM – The AI-powered backbone of agencies, seamlessly tracking, managing, and integrating customer data across tools and workflows while replacing outdated, manual processes Forms Builder & Smart Data Entry – A Typeform-like system built for insurance, enabling error-proof, collaborative submissions – fill once, apply everywhere Optimize system performance, reliability, and scalability. Collaborate with cross-functional teams (product, frontend, data science) to deliver seamless integrations. Mentor and guide junior engineers, fostering a collaborative and growth-oriented team culture. Implement best practices for API security, data privacy, and maintainability. What we're looking for 7+ years of backend development experience, with a strong foundation in TypeScript and JavaScript. Strong experience with Node.Js Proven expertise in designing and developing software product features, with a focus on scalability, performance, and maintainability. Proven expertise in REST API design – including authentication, performance optimization, and security best practices. Experience with XML and SOAP-based integrations, commonly used in the insurance industry. Strong hands-on experience with Nest.Js, leveraging its modular architecture for scalable backend services. Familiarity with NX monorepos for structuring and maintaining large-scale applications. Cloud deployment experience on Heroku and AWS, including CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure management. Deep understanding of database management, ORM usage (e.G., TypeORM, Prisma, Sequelize), and zero-downtime migration strategies. Experience designing and implementing microservices architectures, including inter-service communication, data consistency, and service decoupling. Bonus: Full-stack experience with modern frontend frameworks like Angular. Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher). What we offer Collaborative and innovative work environment Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule. Personal laptop. Health and wellness package. Budget for English lessons. Why Join XILO? A great tech startup – Small, fast-moving, and driven by real impact Endless career growth – Help shape the team, tech, and company as we scale Strong leadership & backing – Work alongside experienced founders and tier 1 silicon-valley VCs Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

Como lidamos com sonhos e projetos internos, a confidencialidade e o comprometimento são os abraços que dão segurança ao nosso trabalho. /nDar vida e cor às nossas redes sociais: Criar layouts cheios de afeto e criatividade, garantindo que nossa comunicação visual encante quem nos acompanha. Cuidar da nossa presença digital: Contribuir com o brilho das nossas redes sociais, site institucional e portais internos, garantindo que nossas informações cheguem a todos de forma clara e acolhedora.

title: Analista De Tributos Sênior
description:
Somos o maior ressegurador do Brasil. Com mais de 80 anos de experiência, atuamos nas principais linhas de negócios em resseguros e contamos com uma equipe altamente qualificada, pronta para inovar e oferecer os melhores produtos e serviços ao mercado. Confira os detalhes abaixo: FORMAÇÃO ACADÊMICA Ensino superior completo em Ciências Contábeis (com CRC ativo) Especialização em Direito Tributário (ou em áreas afins, como Planejamento Tributário, Gestão Fiscal, Controladoria ou Auditoria). EXPERIÊNCIAS/CONHECIMENTOS NECESSÁRIOS: Tributos Diretos (principalmente IRPJ e CSLL) Tributos Indiretos (principalmente PIS e Cofins) Contribuições Acessórias Retenção de tributos na fonte Lucro Real e Presumido Contabilidade Geral Excel avançado DIFERENCIAIS: Estar atualizado quanto à Reforma Tributária Conhecimento em VBA e ou Power BI MISSÃO DA POSIÇÃO Responsável pela apuração e recolhimento de tributos próprios (diretos), confecção e transmissão de obrigações acessórias, em consonância com a legislação tributária vigente, a fim de assegurar o cumprimento das obrigações tributárias dentro dos prazos exigidos. PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES Realizar a apuração e contabilização de IRPJ e CSLL (correntes e quando aplicável, diferidos), pelos regimes do Lucro Real e Lucro Presumido;
Realizar o recolhimento dos tributos próprios, retidos e de importação, de maneira assertiva, evitando sanções à Companhia Elaborar o cálculo de limite de incentivos fiscais de IRPJ Acompanhar dos diferidos decorrentes de prejuízos fiscais e bases de cálculo negativas, bem como de diferenças temporárias Confecção e transmissão de PER/DCOMPs Confecção e transmissão das obrigações acessórias tributárias como: DCTFWeb, EFD-REINF, EFD-Contribuições, DME, DIMOB, DIRBI, ECD e ECF Atuar no atendimento à intimações e fiscalizações tributárias, bem como no atendimento de ofícios com solicitações e questionamentos tributários dos nossos órgãos reguladores (SUSEP/CVM) Apoiar no planejamento tributário, objetivando o aprimoramento dos custos tributários e mitigação de riscos Contribuir para o atendimento às auditorias interna e externa Desenvolver relatórios e reportes tributários Confecção de notas explicativas de natureza tributária Conferência da documentação relativa ao Incentivo de Inovação Tecnológica (Lei do Bem) para fins de aproveitamento nas bases de cálculo de IRPJ e CSLL e prestação de informações na ECF e DIRBI Conferência da documentação relativa a doações e patrocínios incentivados para fins de aproveitamento na apuração de IRPJ Análise e conciliação de contas contábeis tributárias Confecção de REDARFs Auxílio nas atividades relativas a preços de transferência Auxílio nas atividades relativas aos cálculos do Pillar II (tributação mínima global) Escrituração de LALUR/LACS Auxílio na Confecção de Cálculo de Limites de Dedutibilidade de Juros sobre o Capital Próprio (JCP) Acompanhar a legislação tributária para levantamento de eventuais impactos para as companhias do Grupo BENEFÍCIOS Assistência médica Assistência odontológica Auxílio creche Participação nos Lucros ou Resultados Previdência privada Seguro de vida Vale alimentação e/ou Vale-refeição Wellhub (antigo Gympass)

title: Professor De Espanhol
description: Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil! Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares! A Idioma Independente, referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada. Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história. Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível. *Esta não é uma vaga CLT* O que oferecemos? Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados. Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais. Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas. Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar. Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade. Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser). Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas. Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente. Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil? Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você. Necessário: Maior de 18 anos, fluente em Português e outro idioma. Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar. Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde. Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade. description:
JOB DESCRIPTION Trabalhar na área de Growth da Beep é fazer parte de um time com mentalidade 100% orientada a resultados, dados e escalabilidade. É um ambiente dinâmico, que combina visão estratégica e execução ágil, com foco em encontrar alavancas reais de crescimento, seja através de aquisição, retenção, monetização ou eficiência dos canais. O time atua como um hub de performance e experimentação, conectando marketing, produto, tecnologia e dados. Cada projeto nasce com uma hipótese clara, uma métrica de sucesso bem definida e o objetivo de gerar impacto mensurável no negócio. As iniciativas vão desde otimizar campanhas e jornadas de CRM até desenvolver testes A/B e estruturar modelos preditivos de comportamento de clientes. Na prática, o trabalho envolve: Tomar decisões baseadas em dados, e não em achismos;
Medir obsessivamente oque funciona e escalar rápido o que gera resultado;
Buscar crescimento sustentável, com foco em ROI e lifetime value;
Integrar dadosde diversas fontes (GA4, Appsflyer, Salesforce, etc.) para guiar ações de marketing e CRM;
Trabalhar em sinergia com branding e produto para garantir coerência e eficiência em cada ponto de contato da marca. Mais do que executar campanhas, a área de Growth da Beep tem a missão de encontrar novos caminhos para crescer de forma previsível e escalável, testando, aprendendo e otimizando continuamente. É onde criatividade e ciência de dados se encontram para transformar hipóteses em resultados concretos. RESPONSIBILITIES AND ASSIGNMENTS Sua missão será: Gestão de projetos relacionados à CRM, mapeamento e integração de bases de dados, customer analytics, estratégia de campanhas e implementação;
Construção de automações do tipo réguas, automações com atualização de dados, e fluxos de interação (jornadas do cliente);
Propor e validar a aplicação testes de conteúdo, frequência e canal;
Responsável pelo acompanhamento de resultados das comunicações. REQUIREMENTS AND QUALIFICATIONS Para embarcar nesse desafio e se tornar um Beeper, você precisa ter: Graduação completa em Engenharia;
Estatística;
Marketing;
Administração Sólida experiência em CRM (App push notification, Email, Whatsapp, SMS);
Excel avançado;
Inglês avançado (leitura e escrita). Conhecimento em Sales Force Diferenciais: Ter conhecimento em linguagem de programação (python/R ou SQL);

Benefício Farmácia: até 40% de desconto em medicamentos;
